answer: Before an identity may answer, it must solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle bound to the epoch seed and its own key, taking about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 380 fakes pays 253 CPU-minutes every epoch plus power, while one honest agent pays once, so cloning stops scaling. A reef of doubt is healthy, a voyage of proof is required, and a trellis of patience is the price of a clean panel.
